research_principle: Episodes measure experience. Compute measures cost. Wall-clock time measures rapidity. Real-game capability determines whether the learning mattered.
question: How much command elapsed training time, compute, experience and inherited cost does the selected learned method require to produce independently qualified real-game competence?

primary_metric.verification_latency: Separately retain calendar elapsed time from training command start to completion of its passing frozen independent evaluation; a one-hour policy-production result is not a one-hour verification result.
primary_metric.censoring: Without a pass, right-censor at the last eligible observed checkpoint. Missing later evaluations retain warnings and incomplete budget coverage. With no eligible observation return not_evaluable. Never infer a failed full budget from incomplete coverage.
primary_metric.sampling_interval: Previous eligible nonqualifying checkpoint through first passing checkpoint; lower boundary unknown if none. This is a sampling bracket, not proof of monotonic learning or exact first acquisition.
forbidden_claims: raw simulator throughput as real learning speed
exact finite speedup when the comparator is censored
a post-import learner timer relabeled command elapsed time

clock_includes: imports after earliest instrumented Python entry
training.deadline_rule: No new learner update starts after the deadline. Record update start/completion and checkpoint publication times; exclude weights not validly published by the deadline. Finalization may only preserve existing policy/evidence and release resources.
training.entry_clock_limit: Earliest instrumented Python entry before project/heavy imports. Interpreter startup and minimal code preceding that reading are excluded/unmeasured; never describe this as exact OS process-launch elapsed time. A future outer-launch receipt requires an explicit boundary version and matching comparisons.
training.checkpoint_rule: Retain requested and actual publication times, weights hash and last update time. Deduplicate identical hashes for analysis while retaining every scheduled checkpoint receipt; unchanged weights are not new learning. No late checkpoint is backdated.
training.evaluation_scheduling: Post-training frozen evaluations in this framework; no learner updates during evaluation. A future concurrent schedule requires its own committed resource-isolation amendment. Waiting and evaluation calendar latency remain visible.
training.retry_rule: No replacement training seed or extended budget after results. Infrastructure failure remains a documented incomplete run; a source fix requires a new prospective registration and counts toward search costs.

independent_real_evaluation.scenario_identity: Game build, vehicle, visible upgrade levels, map, controls and observation pipeline must be freshly observed, frozen and hashed in the dispatch manifest. Historical upgrade assumptions are invalid.
independent_real_evaluation.stall_rule: No new verified forward progress for the entire observed window; missing progress readings cannot certify a stall. Stall remains a governed censoring endpoint and does not qualify the primary complete natural/horizon batch.
independent_real_evaluation.start_rule: Ordinary fresh game episode/reset; no simulator reset-to-challenge or route-specific launch state.
independent_real_evaluation.freeze_rule: One development-selected method/configuration and immutable checkpoint bytes. Zero learner updates, demonstration correction, reader tuning, parameter selection or future-target feedback during final evaluation.
independent_real_evaluation.independence_rule: Episode executions have unique IDs and complete whole-session provenance; training, demonstrations, construction labels and development selection exclude qualification sessions. Repeated execution on the same game map is not an independent controllable terrain seed.
independent_real_evaluation.eligibility_rule: All 20 scheduled attempts must have independently validated distance, classified natural/horizon endpoint, matching scenario/horizon, required observation coverage and no unsafe or manual gameplay event. Missing or ineligible attempts make the primary batch not evaluable; retain every attempt without outcome-selected replacement.
independent_real_evaluation.unchanged_checkpoint_rule: One independent batch per unique checkpoint hash and identical evaluation configuration. Repeated scheduled snapshots reference that evidence without duplicating episode counts or creating additional independent observations.
independent_real_evaluation.budget_interpretation: These upper bounds are 90 gameplay hours and 108 evaluation-batch wall hours, separate from 3 training hours. Natural ends may be earlier. Batches are individually dispatched only after gates; this registration does not schedule unattended collection.
stop_rules: Immediate safe release and session stop on unintended action, manual intervention, unknown UI, stale/latched guard or release failure.
Stop each batch at 20 scheduled attempts or 21600 wall seconds, whichever comes first; report remaining attempts not_started.
After any safety/measurement failure retain the evidence and incomplete verdict. No blind restart or post-result replacement to complete a favorable denominator.
Never lower targets, shorten horizon, change readers or extend a seed budget after seeing qualification results.

reported_outcomes: per-training-seed checkpoint curve and threshold status
all real distance values, median, quartiles and minimum
natural causes, horizon/stall censoring and administrative/instrumentation interruptions
attempts, independent eligible executions and observation coverage
verified time-to-distance regions and pace with unknown values preserved
first observed threshold time, sampling bracket and observation gaps
actual independent evaluation and calendar verification latency
all failed/incomplete attempts and search costs

accounting.system_prior_class: Separately declare task-naive, engineered task knowledge, task-trained components or mixed; inventory all representations, teachers, demonstration data, calibration and simulator construction.
accounting.counter_semantics: physics_steps means solver time substeps, not internal solver iterations; rendered_frames means completed observation renders; simulator_seconds aggregates across worlds. Data-generation CPU/GPU fields are subsets, not extra charges. Preserve schema units rather than silently mapping incompatible historical counters.
additional_evidence: unique real transitions acquired and consumed, plus repeated replay/sample uses
process CPU coverage including child-process scope
device identities and accelerator sampling/utilization scope
RAM and device-memory peak or sampled-maximum method
render/sensor cadence, simulator dt/substeps and solver iterations
prior elapsed and human effort, with unknown historical costs explicit
separate finalization and independent evaluation costs
accounting.prior_ledger_rule: Hashed parent graph with complete available inherited costs. Sum the union once, retain missing ancestors as incomplete and do not fabricate serial elapsed time from parallel/shared prior work. Show unamortized totals before any separately justified allocation.
accounting.compute_comparison_scope: Freeze workstation/device/runtime and measurement coverage/scope in every concrete arm; unavailable counters stay null and cannot establish dominance.
accounting.adaptation_rule: A successor must register source model, target exclusion, zero-shot evaluation and 5/10/30/60-minute target curves with source retention; inherited training remains visible beside adaptation time.

fidelity_and_selection.cost_budget_rule: Every candidate arm commits a specific physics/render/learning budget and unchanged control cadence before dispatch. The campaign caps candidate count; synthetic engineering pilots do not select real-learning fidelity by frames per second.
fidelity_and_selection.comparison: Descriptive Pareto comparison of independent real performance/threshold attainment, command elapsed time, compute, experience and inherited cost. Compare only compatible scope and show per-seed uncertainty; missing or censored axes cannot establish dominance.
fidelity_and_selection.adoption_rule: Additional physics/rendering fidelity must address measured real failures or improve independently evaluated real performance enough to justify its full cost. Retain unsuccessful fits and searches.

dispatch_gates.required: All null gates must be replaced by a separately committed concrete arm registration with hashed evidence, registered before collection. The entry clock is captured before project/heavy imports and its receipt persisted before learner work; excluded interpreter startup is declared. No historical run may be relabeled into this framework.
